name: 真红眼黑铁龙
nameJa: レッドアイズ・ブラックメタルドラゴン
rarity: 金字UR，爆闪PR，银碎SER，面闪SR，斜碎SCR
desc: 这张卡不能通常召唤。把自己场上1只「金属化·魔法反射装甲」所装备给的「真红眼黑龙」解放的场合可以从卡组特殊召唤。
faq: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set, and must be Special Summoned from the Deck by the condition written on the card. It CANNOT be Special Summoned from your hand. So once it is in your hand, there is no way to Summon this card.
